release_admission.rule: Only an exact entry in release_ready may be published as a library.

portfolio_policy.keep_history: Retire unnecessary packs from the active portfolio and catalog; preserve source locks, reviewed records, receipts, and prior editions needed for reproduction.
portfolio_policy.product_rule: Prefer a small number of complementary, broad libraries with measured retrieval over overlapping topical fragments. Never infer freshness, rights, or quality from availability or package size. A second library over the same project universe in the same language is a duplicate and is rejected, whatever its size. A different-language edition counts as a distinct work only when exact canonical URLs and normalized body hashes do not overlap with an admitted or candidate library.

local_candidate_portfolio.limits: 997,761 short English introductions; host retrieval smoke found 10/12 expected titles (83.3%), 8 at rank 1, 364.7ms median and 1,795.6ms p95. Photosynthesis and Inflation were missed although both expected article IDs exist. Snapshot is older than the September 2026 full-text selection; not complete Wikipedia.

34,599 English travel guides. The published 2026-09.3 count of 34,597 is reconciled: the two extra guides were rejected only by the older body-character policy, and their Unicode replacement characters are upstream in the pinned ZIM. Host retrieval on the 50-case suite found 50 of 50 expected titles, 36 at rank 1, mean reciprocal rank 0.844, median 334.9ms and p95 2,140.6ms; four paraphrase, plural-topic and disambiguated-title questions are recorded as measured misses in the gap case set. That run used an uncommitted `LibraryStore.kt` subject-matching change, so the replay pin must be re-reviewed and the suite re-run before the figures can support an admission. No rights sign-off and no target-device acceptance.

supply_families.scope: Broad encyclopaedic reference coverage from a full, pinned English source edition. Images and third-party media are out of scope until separately reviewed. The released library may use deterministic complementary shards so each Android archive remains within its package limit.

partition_plan.rule: Create the plan only from a complete reviewed source manifest. Publish only complementary volumes whose library payload does not exceed 6 GiB (6,442,450,944 bytes).

selection_requirements: Use one immutable edition with a verified byte digest.
Preserve canonical article URLs and contributor-attribution paths.
Publish an explicit exclusion report for redirects, non-articles, malformed pages, and removed media.
If output requires more than one archive, define deterministic complementary shard boundaries and retrieval cases for cross-shard queries before packaging.
Admitting this family retires wikipedia-top1m-mini from the installable portfolio; it replaces the one English reference identity rather than adding a second overlapping English Wikipedia library.
supply_families.known_limits: A snapshot cannot provide live events or guarantee correctness of individual articles.

supply_families.scope: A complete pinned English travel-guide edition, retaining destination and contributor history paths.
selection_requirements: Resolve the existing record-count discrepancy before adopting any successor.
Do not publish a city or country subset when the same full library already supplies those records.
State that schedules, fares, safety guidance, entry rules, and opening hours may have changed.
supply_families.known_limits: No map tiles, routing, live transport, or current availability claims.

supply_families.scope: Reviewed, bounded entity facts selected from an immutable Wikidata source edition; not a live knowledge graph.
selection_requirements: Define permitted properties and data transformations before acquisition.
Retain entity identifiers and revision/snapshot identity for every record.
Exclude claims whose provenance, ranking, or temporal qualifiers cannot be rendered in the reader.
supply_families.known_limits: It cannot answer unmodeled facts, resolve every entity ambiguity, or supply current values.

supply_families.scope: Region-sharded named place snapshots with an exact query, raw snapshot digest, object URLs, source timestamp, and visible OpenStreetMap attribution.
selection_requirements: Release only a reviewed geographic shard; do not claim worldwide coverage from one query.
Preserve ODbL obligations and any database-derivative requirements before distribution.
Do not infer open-now state, distance, route, quality, safety, popularity, or recommendations.
supply_families.known_limits: Place tags and geometry are snapshots and may be incomplete, stale, or locally inconsistent.

supply_families.scope: Separately reviewed official public guidance, grouped by jurisdiction and subject instead of mixing incompatible national advice into one global authority. The first edition consolidates 23 U.S. federal pages from the seven retired single-topic packs: 23 records, 211 passages, a 372,736-byte payload.
selection_requirements: Approve rights and reuse conditions for every publisher and page.
Keep jurisdiction, publication date, and local-authority limitations visible on every record.
Split a source into a new immutable edition when its advice or rights change.
Refresh a moved page set with `python -m blobs_corpus.web_pages refresh`, which keeps the reviewed selector and identity and records the changed sources in refreshed_from lineage.
supply_families.known_limits: Official guidance can still be jurisdiction-specific, time-sensitive, and unsuitable for emergency or professional advice without current local confirmation.

supply_families.scope: Complete pinned Portuguese Wikivoyage edition as a distinct-language travel work. Measured on the retained snapshot: 4,097 guides from 4,790 archive entries, mean body 6,048 characters, 95 guides without a MediaWiki revision id, and 2 guides carrying one upstream Unicode replacement character each.

partition_plan.rule: Projected installed payload is far below the 6 GiB limit, so one volume is planned. Recompute from the reviewed manifest before packaging.

selection_requirements: Extend the Kiwix curation allow-list and record the changed review-policy identity before curating a non-English edition.
Decide and document how the four exact-duplicate body groups (36 excess records, mostly 167-character boilerplate town stubs) are reviewed, not silently shipped.
Keep the measured non-overlap proof with the English candidate in the release record: zero shared canonical URLs and zero shared normalized body hashes.
Require Portuguese-language retrieval cases and a model that is measured in Portuguese before any catalog entry.
supply_families.known_limits: 2,349 of 4,097 guides are shorter than 1,000 characters, so coverage is broad in place names and thin in detail. No map tiles, routing, live transport, or current-availability claims. Portuguese questions still pass through English-only stop-word and follow-up handling in the Android query layer.

supply_families.scope: Pinned Indonesian Wikipedia most-read lead-section edition as a distinct-language reference work, sized for a single Android volume.

partition_plan.rule: Confirm the measured installed payload stays below 6 GiB after review; the 1,399,953,305-byte source archive projects into a single volume.

selection_requirements: Extend the Kiwix curation allow-list and record the changed review-policy identity before curating.
Measure canonical URL and body-hash overlap against the English reference candidate and publish the result; shared topics are not duplicates, identical works are.
Require Indonesian retrieval cases and an Indonesian-measured model pairing before any catalog entry.
supply_families.known_limits: Lead sections only, not full articles, and Indonesian Wikipedia coverage differs from the English edition. A snapshot cannot provide live events or guarantee article correctness.
